verdict.rationale: Secureframe runs built-in background automation: continuous daily monitoring with alerts for failing tests, automated evidence collection through 100+ integrations, and automatic shadow-IT detection. Users can also configure recurring access and vendor reviews, reminders, and tasks synced to Jira/Slack or ticketing tools. However, these are mostly pre-defined platform automations rather than user-built autonomous automations or agents, and the MCP server is a data-access interface rather than a background automation engine. missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder (custom triggers and actions), autonomous AI agents that act unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
